title: Florine Orphelin
summary:
Florine Orphelin is a Belgian actress who voiced Zhalia Moon in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. 

In other French dubs, she is notably the voice of Chihiro in the animated movie Spirited Away, of Astrid Hofferson in the animated movies Dragons and of Hannah Baker in the television series 13 Reasons Why.
